array.string: set -euo pipefail export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Logs/OpenChamber" exec >> "$HOME/Library/Logs/OpenChamber/launchagent.log" 2>&1 cd "$HOME" exec "$HOME/dotfiles/bin/useenv" fnm exec --using default openchamber serve --foreground
